name: Webslinger

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
Your natural ability to create silken webs blends with your magical powers, allowing you to create impossibly large webs with great frequency. This has the effects of a 2nd-rank Web spell using your class or spell DC, whichever is higher.
